abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC (dispatched by nothing) whose effect was RESTRICT_DEFENSE_TO_HEAD_EQUIPMENT -- Headbutt's 'can't be defended by NON-HEAD EQUIPMENT'. The card restricts ATTACK ACTION CARDS by COST, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped -- nothing to do with equipment slots. The threshold is an expression resolved when the restriction is created, which is when the attack is played.

_comment:
Implementation copied verbatim from heavy_artillery_red, whose printed functional text is identical to this card's once each card's own name is substituted out. Everything that differs between them -- cost, pitch, power, colour -- comes from the card DB, not from this file, so the DSL is the same card twice.

THE COPY IS PINNED, not trusted: tests/test_copied_card_implementations.py asserts that these abilities still match heavy_artillery_red's and that the two printed texts still agree, so a later edit to one cannot silently leave the other behind. That is the insult_to_injury failure -- three printings of one sentence with three different implementations, the blue one missing a gate the others had.
